business_summary: Wing Lee Development Construction Holdings Limited, an investment holding company, operates as an infrastructure contractor in Hong Kong. It operates through Civil Engineering, Electrical and Mechanical Engineering, New Energy, and Others segments. The company engages in civil engineering works, including road and drainage work, such as construction and modification of roads, carriageways, and pavements; construction of covered walkways; renovation of subways and footbridges; provision of universal accessibility facilities at footbridges, elevated walkways, and subways; construction of drainage systems, manholes, and cable trenches; and installation of water mains and sewerage pipes, as well as site formation works, which include earthworks, excavation, and installation of steel structures. It also provides electrical engineering works, including cable trenching, laying, and jointing; excavation, reinstatement, and miscellaneous construction work, such as concrete draws; traffic impact assessment; and emergency and cable fault repair services. In addition, the company is involved in the design, installation, and maintenance of solar photovoltaic (PV) systems; undertaking of solar PV projects; sale and distribution of new energy equipment, electric commercial vehicles, and electric engineering and construction machinery; construction of charging piles and battery swap equipment; battery recycling and energy storage; and underground cable laying and connection projects. Further, it leases machinery; and trades in construction materials. The company was founded in 2005 and is headquartered in Tsuen Wan, Hong Kong. Wing Lee Development Construction Holdings Limited operates as a subsidiary of Wing Lee Green Development Limited.
business_summary_ko: 투자 지주 회사인 Wing Lee Development Construction Holdings Limited는 홍콩에서 인프라 계약자로 운영됩니다. 토목공학, 전기 및 기계공학, 신에너지 및 기타 부문을 통해 운영됩니다. 회사는 도로, 차도 및 포장 도로의 건설 및 개조와 같은 도로 및 배수 공사를 포함한 토목 공사에 종사합니다. 지붕이 있는 통로 건설; 지하철 및 인도교 개조; 인도교, 고가 통로 및 지하철에 보편적인 접근성 시설 제공; 배수 시스템, 맨홀 및 케이블 트렌치 건설; 상하수관 설치, 토공사, 굴착, 철골 구조물 설치 등 부지조성공사 등이 포함됩니다. 또한 케이블 트렌칭, 부설 및 접합을 포함한 전기 엔지니어링 작업을 제공합니다. 굴착, 복원 및 콘크리트 도면 작성과 같은 기타 건설 작업; 교통 영향 평가; 긴급 및 케이블 결함 수리 서비스. 또한 이 회사는 태양광 발전(PV) 시스템의 설계, 설치 및 유지 관리에도 참여하고 있습니다.
